title: Animak
dek: A hesitant arrival whose strange lantern makes Arjahn’s first offer of help unexpectedly complicated.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
The lantern and the lighthouse

Animak arrives holding a lantern and wearing a heavy white jacket. He tells Arjahn that his memory is unclear, that he thinks he has just died, and that a benefactor tethered his soul to the lantern. The benefactor’s identity and the full terms remain unestablished.

An observed disappearance

When Animak opens a panel, he becomes ghostlike and disappears inside the lantern. Arjahn picks it up and hears him answer. Animak describes a comfortable lighthouse-like interior, then emerges through a door and takes the lantern back. The disappearance and return are witnessed; his explanation of the soul-binding remains his account.

A guide who admits fear

Arjahn walks him toward Pristinia, offers practical information and shares something of his lost family. Animak apologises for touching that grief. Their conversation makes the welcome an exchange between two vulnerable people, rather than a veteran simply issuing instructions.
